description:
The Fremen sietch is not presented as generic tribal flavor. It is the cultural center of the Arrakis campaign: practical, disciplined, and organized around survival in a world where waste is a moral failing.

That framing helps the mod feel less like a reskin and more like a distinct colony fantasy. The player is not only harvesting new resources. They are building under a new code of necessity.
name: Fremen sietch

identity.body: Their presence gives the setting tone. Stillsuits, crysknives, sandwalking, and survival agriculture read as parts of one society instead of isolated content pieces.

overview.body: A sietch is the mod's clearest social promise: people adapted to Arrakis rather than merely stranded on it.

waterDiscipline.body: Water is not just inventory to the Fremen. It shapes custom, authority, and daily behavior, which makes the faction a natural anchor for the mod's mechanical focus on thirst and conservation.

summary: A hidden Fremen desert polity bound by water discipline, local law, and hard-won knowledge of Arrakis. In this mod, the sietch is the social model the player is trying to deserve.
